newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel narrowly mixed, Gulf sellers scarce.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel narrowly mixed, Gulf sellers scarce.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices fell moderately in New York Harbor Friday but held steady in the Gulf Coast as firmer diffs offset lower NYMEX futures, players said.

New York Harbor 54-grade jet was offered at about 1.0 cents over the print, about 0.25 cent weaker than Thursday diffs, with Gulf differentials firming about 0.25 cent in thin talk to about 1.50 cents below the print.
"Offers are very hard to find," one Gulf trader said, adding sellers seemed unwilling to let loose of barrels while U.S. distillate stocks continue scraping bottom.
